name: Slabhouse

headline: Custom live edge, river and Ash Resin tables in Dubai UAE
lede: Order custom live edge and river tables in Dubai. Premium walnut slabs, Ash Resin, restaurant tables & vanity counters.
about: Every wood slab has its own story, and we love bringing those stories to life through our handcrafted tables. From sourcing the perfect slab to carefully shaping and finishing each piece, our process is a labor of love.
From slicing charcuterie to serving cheese and crackers, our boards are versatile and perfect for any occasion. Serve up something special with our artisanal serving boards.
